rows.en:
"Yukie☆
I told you not to be deceived, didn't I☆
Very well, I'll show you.
Who the organ woman really is..."{p}

When she came to, Okazaki was lying in the school at night.
"Wh-where am I...?"
The paralysis had lifted.
When she stood up, she could see that organ and the beautiful schoolgirl.
She herself was standing in the hallway outside the music room.
"Yukie, look closely..."
It was the woman's low voice, the one she had heard in her bed.
And when she strained her eyes...{p}

Beside the organ, the figure of a man she didn't know rose into view.
He was gripping a knife in his hand.
With its blade, he began stabbing the beautiful schoolgirl in the head, again and again.
And from the schoolgirl's head, the blood came gushing out...
"Aaaaaaah☆"
Okazaki let out a piercing shriek.
"Yukie, the organ woman was a schoolgirl who was murdered here long ago.
She has nothing whatsoever to do with your mother.
Look at this atrocity.
This really happened at this school, years ago.
Yukie...
I told you not to let yourself be deceived.
That schoolgirl is an earthbound spirit.
An evil spirit that deceives and kills naive, sheltered young ladies like you.
Look..."{p}

The man with the knife noticed Okazaki.
And he slowly came toward her.
Raising the knife as he came.
The beautiful schoolgirl was muttering, her stabbed head swaying.
"I'm your mother, I'm your mother, I'm your mother..."
Okazaki's mind froze with terror.
"Mother☆ Help me☆
Mother☆"
She begged desperately for help.
From the woman with the low voice, that is.
But...
"Yukie. I warned you.
I am not your mother.
I never said a single word of the sort, did I?
No, no. If you want to make a wish of me, you have to hold the Rubelize.
My sweet Yukie..."{p}

Okazaki tried to flee from that place, screaming and sobbing.
But the man with the knife pinned her down...{p}
"Aaaaaaaagh☆"{p}

......
Okazaki was found in the music room the next day.
They say she was dead, covered in blood, with her head jammed in the organ.
The school decided it was an accident.
Everyone knew that Okazaki sometimes stayed late at school, you see.
She must have had an accident while she was up to something secret.
That was the rumor that went around.
Her father had the police look into it in all sorts of ways, but...
In the end, the culprit who killed her was never found.
Of course they couldn't find anyone.
After all, it was an earthbound spirit that killed her...{p}

What Okazaki wished for from the Rubelize certainly came true.
She got to meet the woman who played the organ many times, and she even found out who she really was.
But because of that, Okazaki was killed.
If she had been more careful, perhaps it wouldn't have ended this way.{p}

The person who found Okazaki's body said they thought they heard a woman's low voice behind them.
"My sweet Yukie...
You should have wished more clearly.
To let you meet your mother.
Your mother is alive.
She had cut all ties with your father, but...
She truly was alive, and yet..."{p}

When the person who heard the voice turned around, they say a Rubelize pendant was lying there.
It was giving off a very beautiful light, apparently.{p}

...{a}{f:|}.
Do you feel sorry for Okazaki?
Do you think the Rubelize is a devilish stone?
...But there was a time when the Rubelize gave her happiness.
The sound of the organ that earthbound spirit played truly did make her happy, after all...{p}

She stared intently at the keys.
Then, after a while, she went to close the lid.
"I'd better not play it after all..."
She was curious about the organ, but she felt she shouldn't touch it without permission.
And then...
"Hey, hurry up and go home☆"
A teacher came along and scolded her.{p}

"Yukie☆ Come to me☆"
She heard the woman's clear voice.
Okazaki couldn't hesitate any longer.
She held her breath and tried to get up all at once.
"M-my body... I can move☆"
At the same time, she found she could use her voice again.
"Mother☆"
Okazaki ran toward where the clear voice was coming from.
"Yukie☆ I warned you☆
That woman is..."
The low female voice.
And then...{p}

"Aaaaaaaaaah☆"
What stood there was a mummy in a school uniform.
With its bony hand, skin still clinging to it, the mummy gripped Okazaki's arm hard.
And in a beautiful, clear voice, it spoke to her.
"You fell for it.
I'm no mother of yours.
You had the Rubelize, didn't you?
Then you should've just wished to meet your mother, shouldn't you?
Heh heh heh......"
(M... Mother☆)
Okazaki prayed desperately.
If her mother was out there somewhere...
If she called to her with all her heart, maybe she would come, she thought.
But...
Her mother's spirit never came to help her.
Because her mother was alive.
She had cut ties with her father, but she was living her life somewhere, safe and sound.
Heh heh...
Okazaki was taken away by the spirit of the schoolgirl who had played the organ.
Her soul was torn right out of her.{p}

It seems the schoolgirl's spirit was an earthbound spirit that had attached itself to the organ.
Did you know?
They say spirits easily attach themselves to instruments that haven't been used for a long time.
Okazaki just happened to be the one the spirit preyed on, that's all.
Now there's no knowing who that low voice that warned her really was.
Well, I can more or less imagine.
Heh heh...{p}

Oh, I see.
Then I suppose you can't understand how she felt, putting her wishes into the Rubelize.
But you know, {a}{f:|}.
Her wishes really were granted.
That stone truly had a mysterious magic power.
Maybe some devil lived inside it.
...Am I not supposed to say things like that?{p}

Well, it's a stone that grants wishes.
No matter what fate it brings about.
Heh heh...
I'll tell you what happened to her.{p}

Heh heh... Of course.
There's this much proof, after all.
You can't help but believe it, can you?
I'm glad you believe me.
Actually, I was going to tell you about Okawa next, but maybe I'll change my plans.
The thing in my pocket... do you know what it is?
Judging by your face, it seems you do.{p}

Yes... I'll show you.
This is the Rubelize.
Well? Don't you think its light is divine?
You want to know why I have it?
Heh heh... Does that really matter?
Have you forgotten?
With this, any wish at all is yours for the taking.
As a special favor, I'll lend it to you.
You must have some wish of your own too, don't you?{p}Don't you want the Rubelize to grant it?
Of course
I don't want to rely on something like that

Of course you do.
Now, take the Rubelize in your hand.
Picture your wish in your heart.{p}What could your wish be, I wonder...?
I want to be rich
I want a perfect score on the next test

Suddenly, the door opened.
A teacher was standing there, pale-faced.
The teacher came right up to {f:me|me} and put a hand on my shoulder.
"{a}... listen. Stay calm and hear me out.
There's been a gas explosion at your house.
It seems your whole family was killed instantly.
Go home right away, all right?"{p}

............{f:What did you say|Wh-what}?
{f:I|I} couldn't grasp what I had just been told.
A gas explosion?
All of them killed instantly?
...{f:My|My} family?
When I came to my senses, the teacher was already leaving the club room.{p}

The teacher had said something about calling a taxi for {f:me|me}, or whatever.
Even so, {f:I|I} just stood there like an idiot.{p}

The Rubelize fell from my hand and rolled away.
Someone's hand picked it up.{p}

...It was Iwashita{f:|}.
"Heh heh... Look, it's grown even brighter.
The Rubelize, you see, grants people's wishes, and calls misfortune in exchange.
With every misfortune it brings, it becomes a more and more beautiful stone."
{f:My|My} wish...?
At that moment, {f:I|I} understood.
Ah............ so that's how it {f:was|was}.{p}

Why do you think Okazaki went through what she did?
If it was going to grant her wish, there must have been any number of other ways to do it.
...The Rubelize is a terrifying stone.
While it grants people's wishes, it carries misfortune to them as well.
Listen, {a}{f:|}.
Think about it.
Isn't that just what life is like?
There are happy times, and there are unhappy times.
There are unhappy people, and there are happy people...
What if that is each person's fate?
What if fate is happiness and misfortune tangled together...?
Then perhaps a fate changed by the Rubelize's power brings both happiness and misfortune with it too.
Even if it grants every one of its owner's wishes...
At the same time, it brings a terrible fate along with it.
Perhaps the Rubelize is that kind of stone.
Heh heh...
Let's get back to the story.{p}

Okawa clutched the Rubelize in front of Okazaki's grave and prayed.
Make me as happy as I can possibly be.
After desecrating a dead girl's grave, without even putting the earth back, she prayed for her own happiness.
Maybe it was guilt over robbing Okazaki's grave that made her do it.
If she prayed to the Rubelize for happiness, she would be safe.
Perhaps that's what she was thinking.
Okawa prayed for her own happiness.
She wanted the greatest happiness there is.
And then...{p}

Her body suddenly felt light, as if floating.
Her head filled with happy feelings.
Well, not happy, exactly...
More a giddy, cheerful sort of feeling.
And then Okawa fell asleep.
Her head went hazy, and she collapsed right there.
In front of Okazaki's grave...{p}

They say Okawa breathed her last, just like that.
...The Rubelize took her life.
But her wish was granted.
Okawa's wish was to be given the greatest happiness.
Okawa had a horrible personality, didn't she?
So I suppose it was already fated that she would cause all kinds of trouble later on.
And so the Rubelize made its judgment.
That she would be happier dying early...
That this was the greatest happiness of all...{p}

Heh heh...
Okawa was a fool.
If it were me, I'd seize happiness with my own hands.
I'd get it even if I had to kill someone for it.
Fate is something you carve out for yourself...
My story ends here.{p}In the end, the seventh one never came.
Still, I was quite well entertained.
Well then, shall we head home soon...?{p}

Oh, I see.
I was sure you, of all people, would go along with it.
...Ah, somehow this has become boring.
I don't want to talk anymore.
That's fine, isn't it? I've already told my share, haven't I?{p}If the next person isn't coming, shall we just go home?{p}

...For an instant, I thought the Rubelize glowed.
It felt like my blood was flowing better, somehow...?{p}

The Rubelize fell from {f:my|my} hand as I gasped.
Iwashita picked it up.{p}

"My, your face is bright red."
Iwashita said it with a delighted look.
"It's just as if your blood were rushing to your head with tremendous force."
{f:I|I} was in no state to answer.
My head ached, and everything before my eyes {f:was|was} blurring red.
I clutched my head and crouched down.
No, it can't be, it can't be............
Was {f:my|my} brain growing at a furious rate to {f:become|become} a 'genius'?
But how could something like that...
Suddenly, something snapped right by my ear.
With that, unable to withstand the change, {f:my|my} consciousness went pitch black and vanished.{p}
The Rubelize's glow was reflected in {f:my|my} empty eyes...{p}

"I'm sorry. I have something to do today."
She turned him down.
She didn't really have anything to do, but he was acting far too strangely.
"Can't be helped, then.
In that case, could you at least lend me the Rubelize?"
That's what Fujiomi said.{p}What would you do?
Don't lend it to him
Lend it to him

"I see..."
Fujiomi's shoulders slumped in disappointment.
As you'd expect, Okazaki began to feel sorry for him.
"Well, I can keep you company for a little while, then..."
That's what she ended up saying.
Fujiomi was delighted.
Seeing that innocent expression of his, Okazaki felt relieved.
'It was wrong of me to think he was scary...' she told herself.{p}

Okazaki handed the Rubelize to Fujiomi.
Fujiomi was overjoyed.
And as soon as school let out, he hurried off.
Okazaki had a bad feeling about it, so she followed him.{p}

Then he went to the main road near the school.
And there he was, gazing down at the traffic from a pedestrian bridge.{p}

Could he be planning to kill himself★
What if he had asked the Rubelize to let him die without feeling any pain?
Okazaki ran up the pedestrian bridge.
And she screamed at Fujiomi's back.
"Noooooooo☆"
Fujiomi turned around.
She leapt at him to hold him back.
But in that instant, he smoothly sidestepped her.
Okazaki lost her balance and slammed into the metal railing.
And then... the railing crumbled away.
Just like a lump of sand.
Of course, off balance as she was, she fell headfirst onto the road.{p}

............They say she was run over by a car where she landed and died instantly.
No one ever knew why a railing that wasn't even rusted had crumbled.{p}
But... here's what I think.{p}

That maybe Fujiomi's wish was to kill Okazaki.
I don't know the reason.
Maybe because she cared more about the Rubelize than about him... something like that.
She just happened to come along at the very moment he was about to lay the curse.
Bad luck, or plain foolishness, I couldn't say.
Heh heh, I shouldn't speak ill of the dead, should I?
Oh yes, they say the Rubelize was lying beside her body.
Why would Fujiomi have left it behind...
When you think about that, doesn't my jealousy theory from before sound rather plausible?{p}

...My, look at that face.
That's the face of someone who can't believe a word of it.
So you can't agree with my opinion, is that it?
..............................
..............................
..............................
..............................
............Somehow I'm tired of talking.
Let's end my story here.
It seems you find it boring anyway, {a}{f:|}.{p}Still, I wonder what's keeping the next person.
If no one's coming, shall we just go home?{p}
